svg.text: netmon · home network & endpoint security monitoring
Security Onion · Elastic · UniFi · AI provider of your choice · web search · local LLM (optional)
Risk · Fix list · Lateral map + admin access · ATT&CK
Web Push urgent notifications · per-user device subscriptions
audit log: every user action + AI conversation
weekly rebuild + scans: Semgrep · Bandit · ESLint · Trivy · Gitleaks · ZAP
• Elasticsearch is queried read-only; the one write is the dashboard's append-only audit log (index logs-netmon). netmon never changes UniFi or the network.

• Research job (every 30 min-24 h, set on the dashboard): AI triage, a reviewer that copies similar earlier notes (marked as copied) or sends events to research, and event research with read-only tools; needs a reasoning-capable model. First run after 05:00 UTC adds the briefing + PDF.
• Every 15 min: deterministic watcher → alerts table → Web Push to subscribed users. Nothing is posted to chat.
• Ask AI: dashboard chat with the chosen model; only web search/fetch + read-only netmon tools (no terminal/files/memory).
• Host broker: the dashboard has no Elasticsearch key; time-range collection and reviewer look-ups go through host_broker.py.
• Correlation: the script proposes links; the admin's chosen model confirms or rejects each one - Local LM Studio is optional, any configured provider works (AI review > Models).
• Audit log: every user action and every app ↔ LLM conversation (prompt, answer, model, tokens) → logs-netmon; More → Audit log (admins).
